title: Milan: treadmill incline steady
terrain: treadmill 8-10% incline, climbing only, zero descent
coachNotes: Climbing strength with no eccentric cost, which is the whole argument for a treadmill in a flat week. Hold the incline and let the pace be whatever it needs to be, the gradient is the prescription and the speed is not. This is also race-pace climbing effort, so learn what 80-88% feels like when it is boring. GUT TRAINING: 60 g/h from minute 30, on this run too. Transporter capacity adapts over about two weeks of repeated exposure, so the adaptation either starts now or it does not happen before 5 September. Put carbohydrate in the bottle rather than trying to chew your way there. No gym today, legs recover between Tuesday and Thursday.
